description: This file defines a controller class for managing downloads within the admin panel of an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, deleting, reporting, uploading files, downloading files, and autocomplete functionality for downloads.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class for managing download operations in the admin area, including listing, form handling, upload, delete, report, and autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to set up and display the main download list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the list of downloads via getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders a paginated list of file downloads with sorting options.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a download entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a download entry, either creating or updating.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected download entries after permission and dependency checks.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays a report related to a specific download.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates a detailed report for a download, including recent activity logs.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload requests, performs validation, and moves uploaded files.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Streams a file download if the file exists, or displays not found error.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of downloads for autocomplete input fields.
